ytdlp.title: Qualcomm made a Pi 5 killer. Good luck getting one.
ytdlp.description:
The Radxa Dragon Q8B is more than twice as fast, has twice the I/O, and is only a little bit larger than the Raspberry Pi 5. But it costs a smidge more, and can be hard to find.

Links to things I mentioned in this video:

  - My SBC Reviews website: https://sbc-reviews.jeffgeerling.com
  - Radxa Dr
